A '''[[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]''' fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], against a separatist group known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] was aboard the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] ''[[Prosecutor]]'' when it was [[Attack on the Prosecutor|boarded]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] and subsequently went missing. When the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] reappeared in the [[Corbantis system/Legends|Corbantis system]] of the [[Chaykin Cluster]], he encountered [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], who helped the trooper and two other surviving [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to beat back the assaulting Trandoshans. After the Trandoshan threat was neutralized, Boss ordered this trooper to defend his position from further attack.

==Biography==
The clone trooper was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], cloned and trained on the [[Water/Legends|water]] covered [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="Enc" /> He served as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="SWRC" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'' places the mission on the ''[[Prosecutor]]'' 367 [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], which takes place after the start of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Because ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' states that a galactic standard year consisted of 368 days, this would mean that the mission occurred in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> [[Corbantis system/Legends|Corbantis system]] (''[[Prosecutor]]'') was on board the ''[[Prosecutor]]'' when it was commandeered by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] mercenaries.<ref name="SWRC" />

The clone trooper was in a corridor with two fellow troopers defending the area from Trandoshans with the assistance of some automated defense turrets. He and the other troopers encountered the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], who assisted in defending the area and prevented a trandoshan from turning the turrets on the troopers. Once he did this, the clone showed his stress by making a smart comment to Boss, who in turn reminded the trooper of the chain of command and need for respect, giving the group of clones an order to hold their position while he investigated the source of the Trandoshans.<ref name="SWRC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone trooper's first appearance was in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|first–person shooter]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'', which was released in [[2005]].
